spec: wiki Methods/'Method - Qi fixes training screen' (2026-10-18). User: 'Try training the model with these modifications'.
model: generative predictor of pred_gpc.py (stage 1): residual top-down maps, zero start, T=400, T2=100, 4000 steps, batch 256, unit precision, rule pc, seed 0

arms_per_depth.spklit1: spike=lit1 (step 1 on hidden level j at t=j), base c=2 (stage-1 selection)
arms_per_depth.spkstable: spike=stable: base c=0.1, wavefront step scale c_spike=2.0 (hidden j at t=j, s at t=H); Qi's small-step + spike regime in curvature-normalised units
arms_per_depth.c01: control for spkstable: c=0.1, no spike
arms_per_depth.plain: plain PC rerun in this job (primary comparator; stage-1 seed 0 is a consistency check)
arms_per_depth.c01_fufixed: c=0.1, fixed forward update, no spike (control for the combined arm)
arms_per_depth.qireg: Qi regime: T = T2 = H+1, stable spike (c=0.1, c_spike=2), fixed forward update; prediction also at T=H+1

controls_reused: stage-1 seed 0 (findings/21): plain PC d3 0.381 / d10 0.375; BP auto-decoder d3 0.306 / d10 0.278. Default code path is gated equal to the pre-change code.
no_selection: no step-scale sweep for the new arms (fixed by design); divergence retries at c/2, c/4 as before; flagged

readings.primary: test k_seen k=1 nmse vs the MATCHED control in this job (same depth, same c, seed 0)
readings.classes: |delta| < 0.01: no detectable effect (not 'no effect'); 0.01-0.03: candidate, run seeds 1,2 before any claim; > 0.03 or failure: reportable at screen level
readings.gap_closure: (nmse_plain - nmse_arm) / (nmse_plain - nmse_BP) per depth, BP from stage 1
readings.manipulation: spike arms report spike_s_rel_change; a spike contrast is interpreted only if it is clearly non-zero
readings.credit: cos_ad (fixed probe) at steps 250/1000/4000 is a co-primary mechanism readout
readings.failures: spike arms are not retried; c-changed non-spike arms are reported but excluded from the classes

prior_evidence: diag_c4 (inference-only on trained decoders) predicted both fixes fail; this tests whether training with them changes that
revision: rev 2 after 3 reviewers (31 findings): phase 2 never spikes; no retry ladder for spike arms; failed arms evaluated at last finite weights; names carry c/c_spike/T; per-launch outdir pred_runs/tests_qi; gates test wavefront timing, lit1 exactness, s spike, phase-2 no-spike and an independent fu_grads reference
scope: Screen at one configuration per fix, seed 0. Qi et al. tuned 200 trials per setting; a null here does not refute the fix in general.
